title: Doodha Family In Shanghai

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch - 086. Station, 37
REPORT
File No. 7843
Date March 22, 1937.

Subject DOODHA family in Shanghai .

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by Em Golds. OSI.

Naoroz Bhikhajee DOODHA, British Parsee, born on November
3, 1875 at Navsari, Bombay Presidency, the son of Bhikhajee
Eduljee Doodha, came to China many years ago - prior to 1900 -
when he entered the Chinese Postal Service. He passed through
the various grades in this service until he eventually became
a Postal Commissioner, and in that capacity he has served in
Shanghai, Ningpo, Foochow, Hankow, Yunnanfu, etc. Mr. Doodha
retired from the Postal Service some seven or so years ago,
since when he has been living on pension, and at present is
residing at No. 591 Amherst Avenue.

He has been married twice, both his present and his former
wives being Chinese ladies. The present Mrs. Doodha was
born CHU HUAN-HSUI at Yunnanfu on April 7, 1895. She is now
known as Mrs. Theresa Mabel Doodha.

A very respected member of the local British and Parsee
communities, Mr. Doodha is a committee member of the British
Residents' Association and the Flood Relief Association. He
is also reported to be a director in a number of small local
companies. An excellent linguist speaking seven lanuages
fluently, Mr. Doodha's past conduct, according to discreet
enquiries, is irreproachable.

Mr. Doodha's son by his former marriage is Frank Naval
DOODHA, sometimes known as Frank Norman W. Doodha, who was
born at Foochow on September 28, 1903. This son is not a
Parsee, being the product of a mixed marriage; in this connection
it has to be mentioned that according to Parsee rites, only
children born of parents who are both Parsees are recognised as
being of that race.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科 - 086。第37巡捕房
报告
档案号 7843
日期 1937年3月22日。

事由 上海的 DOODHA 家族。

撰写人 D.S. Pitts。转呈人 Em Golds，情报科督察（OSI）。

Naoroz Bhikhajee DOODHA，英籍帕西人，1875年11月3日出生于孟买管区纳夫萨里（Navsari），系 Bhikhajee Eduljee Doodha 之子，多年前——1900年之前——来到中国，进入中国邮政服务部门任职。他在该部门历任各级职务，最终升任邮政司（Postal Commissioner），并以此身份在上海、宁波、福州、汉口、云南府等地供职。Doodha 先生约七年前从邮政部门退休，此后一直依靠养老金生活，目前居住在爱文义路（Amherst Avenue）591号。

他结过两次婚，现任妻子和前妻均为中国女士。现任 Doodha 夫人原名朱焕翠（CHU HUAN-HSUI），1895年4月7日出生于云南府。她现名为 Theresa Mabel Doodha 夫人。

作为当地英国人和帕西人社区中备受尊敬的成员，Doodha 先生是英国居民协会和水灾救济协会的委员。据报，他还是多家本地小公司的董事。Doodha 先生精通七种语言，是一位优秀的语言学家；根据审慎的调查，其过往品行无可指责。

Doodha 先生与前妻所生之子为 Frank Naval DOODHA，有时也被称为 Frank Norman W. Doodha，1903年9月28日出生于福州。此子并非帕西人，系异族通婚所生；在此需提及，根据帕西礼俗，只有父母双方均为帕西人所生的子女才被承认为该种族。

Frank Doodha 在当地接受教育，离校后

（左侧批注及印章）：
Cf7
Alexander 先生
（印：特务科 / 1937年3月22日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

has held a number of positions in Shanghai. In the past
he has been connected with, among others, Messrs. Silver
Taxi Hire Car Service and Messrs. B. Bertucci (Italian and
Belgian Marble Co. Ltd.) For the last two years, he has
been doing business on his own account as a General Commission
and Import and Export Agent at 25 Rue du Consulat, where
he is at present residing with his wife and family.
Frank Doodha was married in the latter part of 1933
to Miss Tatiana Nicolaevna Prudhovaky, who was born at
Vladivostock on March 6, 1916. Two children have been
born of this marriage.
Apart from the fact that he is reported to have a very
hasty temper, there is nothing on record to this gentleman's
detriment, and according to discreet enquiries made he enjoys
a good reputation locally.

D.C. (Special Branch).                                Ja. Price.
                                                      D.    S.

曾在上海担任过多个职位。过去，他曾与银光出租车行（Messrs. Silver Taxi Hire Car Service）以及 B. Bertucci 公司（意比大理石有限公司，Messrs. B. Bertucci (Italian and Belgian Marble Co. Ltd.)）等机构有过关联。在过去两年里，他在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）25号以一般佣金代理及进出口代理商的身份独立经营业务，目前他与妻子及家人居住于此。
Frank Doodha 于1933年下半年与 Tatiana Nicolaevna Prudhovaky 小姐结婚，后者于1916年3月6日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）。这段婚姻育有两个孩子。
除了据报他脾气非常急躁外，档案中没有任何不利于这位先生的记录，且根据审慎的调查，他在当地享有良好的声誉。

D.C.（特务科）。                                Ja. Price.
                                                      D.    S.
